Daily Digest Tuesday, August 25, 2026

OpenAI Targets Enterprise Advertisers, Claude Expands Google Workspace, Goldman Maps AI Job Impact

OpenAI builds out enterprise ad tools. Claude gets Gmail/Drive integration. Goldman maps where AI is actually impacting jobs.

  1. 1

    OpenAI Sharpens Focus on Enterprise Advertisers

    OpenAI is hiring a head of ads enterprise marketing ($374K-$415K + equity) to shape its positioning as "a premium advertising platform for the world's marketers." The ad manager now includes custom audiences with 25K minimum, campaign health indicators, auto-generated reports for CMOs, and automated headline optimization. The message is clear: small businesses can wait — enterprise wallets come first.

    Read on Digiday ↗
  2. 2

    Claude Expands Google Workspace Integration

    Anthropic's Claude can now send messages through Gmail and manage files in Google Drive. Claude Cowork — the multi-step workflow agent — has expanded to mobile and web interfaces across all paid accounts. This is Claude evolving from assistant to workplace agent: not just answering questions, but executing tasks across your productivity stack.

    Read on Forbes ↗
  3. 3

    Goldman Sachs: AI Squeezing Jobs — But Only in Specific Sectors

    Goldman's new AI labor impact report shows adoption across developed economies has hit 15-20%. But here's where it actually bites: software publishing, management consulting, and advertising are all below historical employment trends. Call centers have been hit hardest — 39% below trend in the US. And entry-level roles are most vulnerable. The takeaway: AI's impact is real but narrow. For now.

    Read on CNBC ↗
  4. 4

    SAP: AI Agent Proliferation Demands Board-Level Governance

    A marketing automation agent here, a supply chain monitoring agent there, an HR onboarding bot elsewhere. SAP's warning: AI agents are proliferating in enterprises exactly like SaaS did — individual teams introducing tools on their own with "genuine productivity goals." The result? Governance chaos. SAP argues AI agent governance is now an executive-board concern, not an IT afterthought.

    Read on Silicon Saxony ↗
  5. 5

    Monetate Acquires Simon AI to Unify CDP + Personalization

    Monetate's Simon AI acquisition connects website personalization tools with unified customer data across digital channels. The real story: AI agents now analyze real-time inventory updates, weather data, and customer interaction histories to select product recommendations and schedule promotional campaigns. The CDP is becoming the intelligence layer — not just the data layer. Read this one: The Goldman Sachs piece on AI labor impact. The data cuts through the hype: AI is already reshaping employment, but in specific, measurable sectors — software publishing, management consulting, advertising, and especially call centers. Entry-level jobs face the most pressure. If you're in PMM, this is the report to understand where the disruption is actually happening versus where we just talk about it happening.

    Read on MarTech ↗
